purpose: Account for every observed pull request, separate the canonical proof-to-pilot product from operational and preserved-research lanes, and enforce a bounded consolidation order.

priority_findings.finding: The current public health receipt reports https://lumen-core.ai/evidence/ at HTTP 502 while five of six monitored endpoints are healthy.
priority_findings.required_action: Inspect the latest production workflow or manually dispatch the bounded deploy, preserve the failed-run receipt, and require HTTP 200 plus the proof-to-pilot evidence marker before closure.

priority_findings.finding: The strongest reviewer package is externally executable but has no completed non-author receipt.
priority_findings.required_action: Rebuild PR 64 on current main, merge one canonical external-review contract, then obtain one named non-author execution receipt.

priority_findings.finding: The evidence graph and reviewer documents require an atomic post-merge update for PRs 66 and 67; PR 69 is only a temporary overlay.
priority_findings.required_action: Update the graph, human evidence index, and consolidation map in one commit, then retire the overlay.

priority_findings.finding: Expired operations, stacked ancestors, superseded route work, and current product work remain open together, increasing reviewer ambiguity.
priority_findings.required_action: Close the eight retire-now pull requests with preserved-history comments and close ancestry only after its canonical successor is merged.

priority_findings.finding: Geometry research exists across Euclidean, spiral, helical, branching, gyroid, phyllotactic, manifold, graph, and topology-aware concepts, but no single current protocol governs physics claims and cross-lane comparison.
priority_findings.required_action: Adopt config/geometry_evaluation_protocol_v1.json and require task-specific frozen baselines, units, invariants, ablations, uncertainty, and negative controls.

merge_program.outcome: Replace the temporary overlay with synchronized graph, evidence index, and consolidation map updates; close PR 69 after replacement.
Rebase or port the fail-closed external-replication docket onto current main and merge after exact-head review.
Use PR 64 as the sole clean-mainline target, preserve frozen negative results, then close stacked ancestors as historical development.
Port durable verifier, release, and deployment identity assets without importing the full historical execution log into the canonical reviewer path.
Merge the security boundary separately from deployment; keep credential provisioning and client migration action-time gated.
Founder-review the bounded sprint, port current trust language, and rebase the exact public release after the evidence spine is stable.
Merge only after founder review confirms that discussion authority remains non-binding and no public asking price is asserted.
Perform a differential review against merged v2; either adopt v3 as the new standard and update every entrypoint, or close it explicitly as unadopted.

retire_now.reason: Superseded, stale, or deadline-expired operational work; preserve branches and receipts but remove them from the active review queue.

retire_after_successor.reason: Extract unique non-duplicated controls into the named successor before closing as preserved ancestry.

active_holds.reason: Wait for a bounded LANL response or close as no-fit; do not imply a completed meeting or relationship.
DICE remains an active deadline lane; keep proposal and legal certifications outside the product merge queue.

maturity_definition.level_1: One coherent public claim and bounded artifact custody.
maturity_definition.level_2: Deterministic first-party replay from pinned source and environment.
maturity_definition.level_3: Externally executable package with fail-closed reviewer controls.
maturity_definition.level_4: Completed named non-author execution receipt with deviations and negative results.
maturity_definition.level_5: Field validation under an authorized owner, locked baseline, metric, window, and acceptance record.
maturity_definition.level_6: Commercial validation supported by signed scope, delivery, and payment or contract evidence.
